# MoMicro

> MoMicro is an AI Agent for e-commerce and Shopify stores. Unlike a scripted
> chatbot, it reads the store's live data, calls any REST API on demand, ties
> each conversation to the signed-in shopper, and resolves customer support
> across both chat and email. A free plan gives any website a chat widget with
> manual replies.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://momicro.com/): What the AI Agent does and how it works
- [How it works](https://momicro.com/how-it-works): The five-step agent loop, from question to resolved
- [AI Chatbot](https://momicro.com/ai-chatbot): Upload business files and answer common questions from them
- [Platform](https://momicro.com/platform): Live database access, any API, per-shopper memory, chat and email
- [Pricing](https://momicro.com/pricing): The three plans and what each one unlocks
- [Docs](https://momicro.com/docs): Installing the widget, connecting APIs, embedding the dashboard
- [News](https://momicro.com/news): Product and company updates
- [Contact](https://momicro.com/contact): How to reach the team

## What it is
- Product: MoMicro — an AI Agent (and AI chatbot) for e-commerce customer support
- Company: MoMicro
- Installed with one script tag before the closing body tag of any website
- Multilingual: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian

## Plans
- Free ($0/mo): chat widget on your website, lead capture, manual replies from
  the dashboard, 20+ languages. No AI replies.
- Connected ($20/mo): everything in Free, plus conversations linked to your
  signed-in customers, full branding (logo, icon, colours), and a dashboard you
  can embed in your own admin.
- AI Agent ($50/mo): everything in Connected, plus AI replies, uploaded business
  files answered via retrieval, live database access, any REST API integration
  at no extra cost, and email resolution.

## Notes
- API integrations are included at no extra cost on the AI Agent plan, and the
  MoMicro team will connect them for you.
- A basic widget is live in minutes; connecting data sources is a guided setup.
